updates.title: Kelvex Security — Updates
updates.heading: Core Updates
updates.description: Check for a newer Kelvex Core release and apply it — over the internet, or by uploading an update file for offline/air-gapped environments. Applying an update does not restart the service automatically.

updates.restart_required_banner: Restart required to apply the update:
updates.restart_windows_command: net stop KelvexCore && net start KelvexCore

licenses.title: Kelvex Security — Licenses
licenses.heading: Licenses
licenses.description: 1 endpoint is always free. From the 2nd endpoint on, a license is required — hardware-bound and time-limited. Licenses are verified entirely offline, no data is sent anywhere.
